params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly removes large blocks of commented-out code, which directly addresses the SonarQube warning about commented-out code sections. The removals are focused solely on deleting unused commented code without altering any functional code or making unrelated changes. Minor comment deletions and whitespace adjustments are acceptable and do not affect functionality. There are no additions or deletions unrelated to the fix, no variable renaming, no print statement changes, and no optimization of computations. Thus, the patch cleanly fixes the warning with minimal impact.
